short: Joint cell typing plus cross-modal prediction
why: Objective names cell-type identification first, then predicting each modality from other
decision: Primary: classification/integration on label_fine (17 classes) and label (8); joint vs RNA alone vs ATAC alone, probe balanced accuracy + macro-F1. Secondary: cross-modal prediction rna->atac (binary_top10000, AUROC) and atac->rna (log1p_hvg2000, Pearson r) vs train-mean baseline. No labels in training (label-free). Success: joint probe bal. acc. on label_fine >= best single modality (CI overlap or better = 'at least as well'); prediction clearly above train-mean baseline. Labels come from RNA (CellTypist) so joint can at best tie RNA; tiny classes (<10 test cells) not conclusive.
evidence: profile.json: n_train=7285; label classes 8, label_fine 17; smallest train class 11
alternatives_rejected: supcon_clip: rejected, objective does not allow labels for training

why: Counts are sparse; depth-normalised, compact inputs train faster and denoise
decision: rna: log1p_hvg2000_pca50 (encoder input); atac: tfidf_lsi50_drop1 (72% nonzeros<=2, 92% zeros, ATAC-like; first LSI comp corr with depth r=0.86 so dropped, 49 dims). Targets: rna log1p_hvg2000 (Pearson r), atac binary_top10000 (AUROC).
evidence: profile.json atac frac_le_2=0.72; features/atac__tfidf_lsi50_drop1.json corr=0.856; rna PCA50 explained var 0.333, atac 0.067
alternatives_rejected: lsi100/pca100: only if fine-label probe weak

why: Cells are paired and prediction across modalities needs a shared space
decision: Baselines: rna_only_pca, atac_only_pca, early_fusion_pca (dim 32). Primary: clip with mlp encoders dim 32, label-free. One alternative: vicreg (many same-type look-alike cells are false negatives for contrastive loss).
evidence: n_train=7285 paired; objective includes cross-modal prediction
alternatives_rejected: supcon_clip: labels not allowed; simclr: single modality

why: Small inputs train in minutes; defaults are standard for this size
decision: clip: mlp hidden256 x2, dim 32, batch 512, lr 1e-3, dropout 0.1, epochs 300 patience 20, max 8 min. vicreg: batch 256, max 5 min. Total planned 13 of 20 min, 7 kept for iteration.
alternatives_rejected: larger dim: not needed for 8 classes

why: CLIP validation loss rose after epoch 11 while training loss kept falling
decision: clip: best_epoch 11 of 31, train loss 1.82 vs val 3.68 at epoch 30, val R@1 0.137 (chance ~0.001); effective rank 12.8/32 on val. vicreg: best_epoch 59 of 79, val R@1 0.053, eff rank 8.4/32. No collapse (sd>0). Action: rerun clip with stronger regularisation.
alternatives_rejected: accept as is: overfit symptom matches training-skill rule (best_epoch <=10% ... borderline)

short: All learned models match RNA on coarse labels
why: Coarse cell types are easy; fine types separate the methods slightly
decision: val probe bal acc label: rna 0.976, atac 0.827, early fusion 0.980, clip 0.981, vicreg 0.984. label_fine: rna 0.849, atac 0.818, early fusion 0.880, clip joint 0.832, vicreg joint 0.868 (CIs ~±0.04, overlapping). Cross: atac->rna per-cell r clip 0.463, vicreg 0.475, atac-only 0.456 vs train-mean 0.30; rna->atac per-feature AUROC ~0.60 for all. Retrieval: clip R@5 0.27, FOSCTTM 0.025 (chance R@5 0.003); vicreg R@5 0.13. Joint CLIP is not above early fusion on label_fine -> iterate on CLIP regularisation.

why: Original CLIP overfit and joint trailed early fusion on fine types
decision: clip_mlp_d32_reg: hidden 128, dropout 0.3, weight decay 1e-3. Trained 0.29 min (best epoch 127 of 147, no early overfit). Val label_fine joint probe 0.900 (was 0.832; early fusion 0.880; rna 0.849); label 0.979; retrieval R@5 0.276/0.265, FOSCTTM 0.024; atac->rna r 0.466. Total training minutes used ~0.7 of 20.
alternatives_rejected: vicreg regularised: not needed, vicreg retrieval 2x worse

short: Choose regularised CLIP as main model
why: Best fine-type score and best cross-modal matching on validation
decision: Report on test: clip_mlp_d32_reg (primary, label-free), vicreg_mlp_d32 (alternative), baselines rna_only_pca, atac_only_pca, early_fusion_pca. Original clip_mlp_d32 dropped (superseded).
alternatives_rejected: early_fusion_pca: close on label_fine (0.880) but gives no cross-modal map

short: Cell typing and cross-modal prediction run
why: These are the two analyses the objective asked for
decision: Test (n=1560). label_fine probe bal acc: clip joint 0.884 [0.858,0.908]; RNA enc 0.852 [0.815,0.880]; ATAC enc 0.838; rna_only 0.831; atac_only 0.833; early fusion 0.849; vicreg joint 0.827. label: clip joint 0.983, rna_only 0.977, atac_only 0.951. atac->rna per-cell r 0.466 [0.458,0.474] vs atac_only 0.457 [0.448,0.465] vs train-mean 0.300; per-gene r>0.3 for 13.5% genes. rna->atac per-sample AUROC 0.671 vs train-mean 0.661, per-peak AUROC 0.597 (0.5 chance); rna_only 0.599. Retrieval R@5 0.28/0.27 vs chance 0.003, FOSCTTM 0.024 (0.5 chance).

short: Use regularised joint CLIP; RNA PCA if cheap
why: Joint matches or beats each modality and adds cross-modal matching
decision: Verdict: Multimodal enables. Joint CLIP embedding is at least as good as either modality for cell types (fine 0.884 vs best single 0.852, CIs overlap, so no proven gain) and uniquely supports cross-modal matching (R@5 0.28 vs 0.003). Prediction of each modality from the other is only modestly above the train-mean baseline (ATAC->RNA r 0.466 vs 0.300; RNA->ATAC per-sample AUROC 0.671 vs 0.661). Caveats: labels predicted from RNA by CellTypist, one donor, tiny classes (2-7 test cells), early fusion PCA is within CI. Would change: RNA-independent labels, more donors.
alternatives_rejected: early_fusion_pca: simpler and within CI on label_fine
